name: Nuan Cheng
overview: Designated Z-Star 2059, Wan Yuan is unexpectedly transported through a wormhole to Ordos’ Nuan Cheng. There, she meets locals dedicated to exploration, community, and protecting the environment. Immersed in their spirit of cooperation, Wan Yuan uses her interstellar abilities to assist a research team, embarking on a heartwarming journey that blends cosmic adventure with human connection and personal growth.
